feeds.title: The DIY Mommy
feeds.description: The DIY Mommy is a crafty DIY, home decor, and lifestyle blog about creating budget friendly, beautiful decor & DIY ideas to create a cozy home & life you'll love! It features DIY home decor tutorials, home organization ideas, unique craft ideas, upcycling ideas, easy family recipes, free printable artwork, and more.

feeds.title: Funky Junk Interiors
feeds.description: Funky Junk Interiors is about decorating with salvaged finds, shopping adventures, travel, easy projects to build, and more.

feeds.title: Rambling Renovators
feeds.description: Rambling Renovators by Jennifer Flores is a Canadian home renovation blog featuring Before and After DIY projects, renovations, home decor ideas, and home remodel tips. Jennifer is a DIYer, mid-life mom, and crafty Canadian with a love for classic style.

feeds.title: Home Made Lovely
feeds.description: I'm Shannon, author and founder of Home Made Lovely. Home Made Lovely is a place where you can get all the inspiration and ideas you need to make home your happy place! Browse 100's of home decor ideas, how-tos, DIY projects, craft tutorials, simple delicious recipes & meal planning, plus entertaining & hospitality tips.

feeds.title: A Pretty Fix
feeds.description: I'm Jelica. Welcome to A Pretty Fix, a home DIY blog about making crafts, decor, and how-tos accessible and fun. Here you'll find ideas, tips, and inspiration to live life more beautifully.

feeds.title: The Art of Doing Stuff » DIY
feeds.description: My name is Karen Bertelsen and I was a television host. The Art of Doing Stuff is a lifestyle blog for people who like to sweat, do stuff and sometimes swear.

feeds.title: Craftionary
feeds.description: I am Hani and I welcome you to Craftionary. Here you will find DIY home and garden ideas, lots of inspirations!

feeds.title: Making it in the Mountains Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kristi, writer, and creator behind Making it in the Mountains. I am a wife, a mother & a teacher. In keeping with our new DIY lifestyle, we've pushed ourselves a bit ton outside our comfort zone by buying our first-ever 'fixer-upper' and what an adventure it's been!

feeds.title: Hello Creative Family » DIY and Craft
feeds.description: At Hello Creative Family, we believe that creative parents raise creative kids. We're an online magazine for parents looking to ignite their creative passion with simple, everyday, and back-to-basics inspired projects. Through craft, diy, and food projects, as well as parenting reads, we will give parents the tools to live, love and teach the handmade, homemade, heart-made lifestyle - no matter their skill level.

feeds.title: Garden Therapy » DIY Projects
feeds.description: Garden Therapy is a blog that focuses on the therapeutic benefits of gardening. With a focus on DIY projects and gardening for mental health, Garden Therapy provides readers with practical tips and inspiration for creating beautiful outdoor spaces. Founded by Stephanie Rose, a master gardener and writer, Garden Therapy is a great resource for anyone looking to improve their mental health through gardening.

feeds.title: Poppytalk
feeds.description: A blog about DIY, design, arts and crafts. Poppytalk is a creative studio and website started in 2005 based in Vancouver, B.C. Founders, Jan Halvarson and Earl Einarson combine their communication and media design backgrounds to design products, DIY projects, and recipe creations from video hacks to well-edited finds.

feeds.title: Dans le Lakehouse
feeds.description: I'm Tanya. Here you'll find modern DIY projects and craft tutorials, home renovation, and home decor projects (big and small, for every budget), and my adventures raising backyard chickens and gardening! It's all served up with a lot of turquoise and a slice of rural life on the shores of Lake Superior.

feeds.title: My Little Secrets
feeds.description: I am Natalie and the DIY fashionista behind My Little Secrets - a DIY and Lifestyle Blog based in Toronto. A strong believer that if you love something, you can make it, My Little Secrets is a haven for the DIY obsessed. Often sharing fashion and home decor DIY projects, my blog inspires and encourages creativity amongst my readers and fans.

feeds.title: Lemon Thistle Blog
feeds.description: I'm Colleen: wife; mom to 4 wild ones; and DIY blogger behind Lemon Thistle. You can expect to see rad DIY, modern home decor, renovations, hand lettering, and the occasional party on Lemon Thistle.

feeds.title: Harlow & Thistle
feeds.description: My name is Andrea, I am the lead designer and blogger at Harlow and Thistle, a design blog for DIY decor and everything in between. I love finding unique ways to create a luxe look for less. Get Interior design inspiration for your home, DIY home decorating ideas to help you achieve lux for less and lifestyle tips for the everyday.

feeds.title: PMQ for two
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Ariel and I'm the voice behind PMQ for two. I create bright, bold, colourful, and eclectic home decor, DIYs and lifestyle content.

feeds.title: DIY Robotics Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the DIY-Robotics blog about industrial robotics. Keep up to date with the latest news and trends in industrial robotics. DIY-Robotics offers a range of pre-engineered, mobile and modular industrial robotic cells, and is also a community of engineers and programmers who want to build the largest open-source knowledge base for DIY industrial robotics.

feeds.title: DIY MOM Blog
feeds.description: Mom blog by DIY MOM Rebekah Higgs includes experiences parenting, renovating, redecorating, restoring, and repurposing. Home improvement, home reno TV show, 2019 trends, Air BNB, small space transformation, Basement, Kitchen, Bedroom, Bathroom, decor, design, beauty, interior decor, accessories, appliances, home organization, tips, and tricks, tutorial, how to, and collaborations.

feeds.title: Young Living Canada Blog » DIY
feeds.description: This section features articles on DIY. We honour our stewardship to champion nature's living energy, essential oils, by fostering a community of healing and discovery while inspiring individuals to wellness, purpose and abundance.

feeds.title: Amy E Peters Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Amy. Find anything from motherhood, style, travel, maybe the occasional DIY, home decor and design, and most of all - documenting our day to day adventures in motherhood.

feeds.title: The Learner Observer Blog
feeds.description: The Learner Observer is a blog established in 2012 where Thalita shares how she's making her house a home. Functional decor, easy DIYs and real life motherhood.

feeds.title: Treasures & Travels Blog
feeds.description: Treasures & Travels is a lifestyle blog by Tegan & Lindsay, two sisters from Vancouver, BC. With a love for all things creative they daily share their favourite recipes, diy projects, outfits, favourite brands, beauty tricks, hair tutorials, and more!

feeds.title: Orange and Lemons Blog
feeds.description: Orange and Lemons provides top-notch content covering trends, crafting, and contemporary interior design, all presented in a user-friendly format. Explore case studies and tutorials designed to empower you to transform your dreams into tangible creations. From detailed material lists to step-by-step instructions, team Orange and Lemons are here to support you every step of the way.

feeds.title: A Pop of Pretty Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kerri. I love the pretty modern cottage and coastal home decorating style. A Pop of Pretty is an established Canadian home decorating blog that shares tips, tutorials, and inspiration on how to style your home pretty. It is packed with DIY projects and conversations about the most pertinent design issues of today.

feeds.title: Erin Rochon Design Blog
feeds.description: Erin Rochon is a Interior decorator and is passionate about upcycling. She has been featured several times on CTV Ottawa Morning Live and Daytime Ottawa teaching viewers about upcycling, furniture refinishing, and DIYs.
